
# "Demo of all OGC specs in one API" OGC API

> Documentation and API endpoints for the [OGC API](https://ogcapi.ogc.org/) involving the "Demo of all OGC specs in one API" dataset hosted at http://localhost:8080.

## Core API Documentation
- [Landing page](http://localhost:8080/?f=md).
- [OpenAPI spec](http://localhost:8080/api?f=md), also available in [JSON](http://localhost:8080/api?f=json).
- [OGC Conformance declaration](http://localhost:8080/conformance?f=md).

## Collections
- [List of all collections available in this API](http://localhost:8080/collections?f=md).

### Collection: addresses
- [View Collection Details](http://localhost:8080/collections/addresses?f=md)
- [View Tiles](http://localhost:8080/collections/addresses/tiles?f=md). OGC API Tiles.
- [View Features/Items](http://localhost:8080/collections/addresses/items?f=md). OGC API Features. Use "next" link to paginate through the features.
- [View Schema](http://localhost:8080/collections/addresses/schema?f=md). OGC API Features part 5 "schema".

### Collection: addresses2
- [View Collection Details](http://localhost:8080/collections/addresses2?f=md)
- [View Features/Items](http://localhost:8080/collections/addresses2/items?f=md). OGC API Features. Use "next" link to paginate through the features.
- [View Schema](http://localhost:8080/collections/addresses2/schema?f=md). OGC API Features part 5 "schema".

## Vector Tiles (OGC API Tiles)
- [View Tiles](http://localhost:8080/tiles?f=md)
- [View which zoom levels are available for the NetherlandsRDNewQuad projection](http://localhost:8080/tiles/NetherlandsRDNewQuad?f=md)
- [View which zoom levels are available for the EuropeanETRS89LAEAQuad projection](http://localhost:8080/tiles/EuropeanETRS89_LAEAQuad?f=md)
- [View which zoom levels are available for the WebMercatorQuad projection](http://localhost:8080/tiles/WebMercatorQuad?f=md)

## Styles (OGC API Styles)
- [Available Styles](http://localhost:8080/styles?f=md) in Mapbox format.
